text: Upstream review 2026-09-01: PR #629 adds CAS for the room ownership race, but its fresh authorization read and later CAS snapshot are still separate. A valid A-to-C handover can authorize on owner A, race with A-to-B, then CAS against B and overwrite it although A is no longer owner. Exact interleaving and remediation: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/629#issuecomment-5491240407
